articles.title: Caps-Habs Tilt Features First Hutson Brothers Meeting
Capitals, Canadiens seeking rhythm in season of high expectations

away.summary: The Devils (4-3-0) are dealing with several absences, including Connor Brown (lower body), Nick Bjugstad (upper body), and Luke Evangelista (illness), with Evangelista confirmed to miss his third straight game. Remi Poirier and Brenden Dillon are scratched. Cody Glass is expected to play despite not practicing Friday due to maintenance. Jake Allen is projected to start in goal, continuing his strong season after reaching his 500th NHL start.

home.summary: The Capitals (4-3-0) will be without key players Rasmus Sandin (knee, LTIR), Matt Roy (lower body, sixth straight game missed), and Pierre-Luc Dubois (illness, fifth straight game missed, on IR). Justin Sourdif is also out due to illness, making way for Jonny Brodzinski's return after being recalled from Hershey. Ethen Frank and Dylan McIlrath are scratched. Logan Thompson is projected to start in goal, with Charlie Lindgren as the backup.
